description.blurb: S/2020 S 9 is a natural satellite of Saturn, belonging to the Norse group. It was discovered in 2020 and announced in 2023.
description.more: S/2020 S 9 is about 4 kilometers in diameter and orbits Saturn at an average distance of 25.4 million km in 1534.97 days. It has an inclination of 161.4° to the ecliptic in a retrograde direction with an eccentricity of 0.531.
